request_text:
I'm requesting the traffic signal drawings & installation plans for the most recent traffic signal modification (current traffic signal layout) at the following locations:


(1) Oak Street & Masonic Avenue


(2) Oak Street & Pierce Street


(3) Howard Street & 5th Street


All locations are in San Francisco, CA.


*Note: The current traffic signal layout at these locations include flashing yellow arrow turn signals. The traffic signal drawings / installation plans must include:


(1) Traffic signal head placement.


(2) Traffic signal face number (ex: signal face #1: red, yellow, green).


(3) Traffic signal phasing diagram.


(4) Flashing yellow arrow signal heads / phases at each location.


I'm requesting only the traffic signal drawings & installation plans for the most recent traffic signal modification at the locations listed above. If possible, please e-mail any documents to jamescalender97@yahoo.com. If there is a fee for receiving e-mailed documents please let me know. Thank you.
